The northern gray municipal graphic near[327,72–73]is a separate feature and is not used.

sourceReconstruction.uncertaintyInterpretation: The exact quarter-stroke identity within this bracket is unresolved. Intermediate coordinates are an explicit manual inference supported by the adjoining chain and repeated complete-island form, not verified quarter-boundary ink. The alternative chord quantifies one source-space choice, not a statistical or absolute accuracy bound.

properties.name: Petőfi-akna

sourceReconstruction.sourceSupport: The dark top stroke ends at[501,18] RGB93/86/94. The visible purple eastern body stroke is certain again at[503,24] RGB130/95/135. In between, pale cap pixels and a descending gray administrative/background line are mixed. The candidate interval records five internal source pixels without claiming each belongs to the quarter stroke. The particularly pale[500,19]and[500,20]pixels are cap/interior evidence, not automatically inserted as external boundary vertices.
